correct_completion: I applied for a job at the hotel.
full_sentence: Because I wanted more experience, I applied for a job at the hotel.
acceptable_variants: I decided to apply for a job in a hotel.
I started looking for work at a hotel.

options.text: the hotel was closed on Monday.
options.why_wrong: This describes a fact about the hotel, but it is not an action that the reason in the stem explains.

options.text: I applied for a job at the hotel.
I have worked at a bank before.
options.why_wrong: This gives past work history, but it does not describe what the speaker did because of the reason.

options.text: the hotel has a big swimming pool.
options.why_wrong: This describes the hotel's facilities, not the speaker's action, so the main clause is left incomplete.

explanation: After 'because', the reason comes first, and the main clause must describe the action that this reason explains. Spanish speakers may be tempted to add a second reason instead of the action, so check that the main clause answers the question why.
translation: Porque quería más experiencia, solicité un trabajo en el hotel.
